title: Is Joao Pedro ready to break Chelsea's so-called number nine curse?
summary: Joao Pedro, Chelsea's new number 9, scored within 31 seconds of his season debut. The focus now turns to whether he can replicate his previous season's 20-goal tally in his new primary striker role.
content: Joao Pedro took just 31 seconds to score his opening goal of the season - will the new number nine reach the 20 he scored last season while wearing the number 20 shirt?
